home.faq3: At Inverfin, we simplify your access to liquidity and productive assets. Here you will find quick answers to the most common questions.
home.q1_question: What is Inverfin and what services does it offer?
home.q1_answer: Inverfin is a financial institution specializing in pure leasing and factoring, helping companies grow without decapitalizing.
home.q2_question: What types of companies can qualify?
home.q2_answer: Sole proprietors with business activities (PFAE) and companies of all sizes that require liquidity or productive assets for their operations.
home.q3_question: Are lease payments or advances tax-deductible?
home.q3_answer: Yes. Lease payments and factoring costs can be tax-deductible in accordance with current tax laws.
home.q4_answer: You can receive pre-approval for your credit line in less than 48 hours, with guidance from an executive at every step.
home.q5_question: Do I need to commit all my invoices or assets?
home.q5_answer: No. You can choose which invoices to advance or which assets to lease according to your specific needs.

arrendamiento.hero1: Obtain machinery, vehicles, or equipment without compromising your liquidity. With Inverfin, access flexible plans that drive your growth and take advantage of tax benefits.
arrendamiento.benefits2:
At Inverfin, we believe every company deserves to grow with solid financial backing.
Discover how our benefits drive your operations and strengthen your competitiveness.
arrendamiento.benefits-card6: Acquire assets without paying the full upfront investment. Keep your cash flow available for working capital and new opportunities.
arrendamiento.benefits-card7: Facilitate the renewal and upgrading of machinery and productive equipment, keeping your business competitive and efficient.
arrendamiento.benefits-card8: Maintain your borrowing capacity and leverage tax deductions applicable in accordance with current laws.
arrendamiento.benefits-card9: Payments aligned with your company's financial profile and cash flow, adapting to your actual needs.
arrendamiento.benefits-card10: Option to acquire the asset at the end of the contract under preferential terms, maximizing your investment.
arrendamiento.problem1: Who is it for and what problem does it solve?
arrendamiento.problem2: Inverfin Pure Leasing is designed for companies looking to grow without decapitalizing, offering agile and flexible financial solutions.
arrendamiento.problem-card2: Corporations and Sole Proprietors with Business Activities (PFAE) that require vehicles, fleets, transport equipment, or industrial machinery without paying the full value of the asset upfront.
arrendamiento.problem-card4: Growing requires investment, but buying assets in cash consumes resources that the company needs for daily operations. Leasing allows you to acquire productive assets without full upfront payments, preserving liquidity for working capital, new operations, and growth opportunities.
arrendamiento.process2: Our process is designed to be agile and transparent. In six steps you can access the liquidity and assets your business needs.
arrendamiento.process-card4: We analyze and authorize your leasing line.
arrendamiento.process-card6: Choose your preferred asset and supplier.
arrendamiento.process-card8: We quote the asset and the corresponding insurance.
arrendamiento.process-card10: We sign the contract and formalize the lease.
arrendamiento.process-card12: We make the payment and deliver the asset.
arrendamiento.faq2: We answer your most common questions about Inverfin Pure Leasing.
arrendamiento.q1_question: What is pure leasing or operating lease?
arrendamiento.q1_answer: It is a solution that allows your business to use productive assets through periodic lease payments, without paying the full upfront cost.
arrendamiento.q2_answer: It allows you to acquire assets without allocating large amounts of capital, preserving liquidity for operations and growth.
arrendamiento.q3_question: What type of assets can I lease?
arrendamiento.q3_answer: Vehicles, fleets, transport equipment, machinery, and other productive assets related to your business activity.
arrendamiento.q4_question: Can I choose the asset and the supplier?
arrendamiento.q4_answer: Yes, you can select your preferred asset and supplier or rely on our partner network.
arrendamiento.q5_question: Can Inverfin help me quote the asset?
arrendamiento.q5_answer: Yes, we have a broad network of suppliers that facilitates searching and quoting.
arrendamiento.q6_question: Can you also help me with insurance?
arrendamiento.q6_answer: Yes, through our partner network, we can assist you in quoting insurance to protect the assets.
arrendamiento.q7_question: What lease terms do you offer?
arrendamiento.q7_answer: They are determined based on the type of asset, its characteristics, and your company's financial needs.
arrendamiento.q8_question: Do I need to make a down payment?
arrendamiento.q8_answer: It depends on the approved structure, the asset, and the operation's profile. Terms are clearly presented from the quoting stage.
arrendamiento.q9_question: Who holds title to the asset?
arrendamiento.q9_answer: During the contract term, Inverfin retains legal ownership, and your company holds the right of use.
arrendamiento.q10_answer: They can offer tax benefits in accordance with applicable laws and each company's tax status.
arrendamiento.q11_question: Can I add multiple assets to my leasing line?
arrendamiento.q11_answer: Yes, an approved line can allow the addition of different assets through subsequent operations.
arrendamiento.q12_question: Can I renew my fleet or equipment?
arrendamiento.q12_answer: Yes, leasing can be part of a periodic asset renewal strategy.
arrendamiento.q13_question: What happens at the end of the contract?
arrendamiento.q13_answer: Alternatives depend on the agreed terms. Our team will guide you through the available options.
arrendamiento.q14_answer: It depends on the information provided and the specific characteristics of each operation.
arrendamiento.q15_question: What documentation do I need to get started?
arrendamiento.q15_answer: Complete the digital onboarding and provide the necessary corporate, financial, tax, and legal information.
arrendamiento.q16_question: Can I contract leasing even if I already have bank lines?
arrendamiento.q16_answer: Yes, leasing can complement your financing sources and preserve capacity in other credit lines.
arrendamiento.q17_question: Does Inverfin handle purchasing the asset?
arrendamiento.q17_answer: Yes, Inverfin completes the purchase directly with the validated supplier and coordinates delivery.
arrendamiento.cta1: Ready to take the next step?
arrendamiento.cta2: At Inverfin we believe that every company deserves to grow with solid financial backing. Request your leasing line and receive personalized advice from our executives.

factoraje.hero1: Convert your invoices into immediate liquidity. Advance the collection of your accounts receivable with Inverfin, improve your cash flow, and take advantage of early payment discounts.
factoraje.benefits2:
Convert your accounts receivable into immediate liquidity.
Discover how Inverfin Factoring strengthens your working capital and accelerates your growth.
factoraje.benefits-card5: Don't wait 30, 60, or 90 days. Advance the collection of your invoices and convert your credit sales into available cash flow today.
factoraje.benefits-card6: Obtain resources directly from your accounts receivable, without the need for additional collateral or traditional debt.
factoraje.benefits-card7: Access liquidity to take on new orders, purchase inventory, pay suppliers, and take advantage of early payment discounts.
factoraje.benefits-card8: Adapt factoring to your company's operational cycles, with revolving schemes that support your growth.
factoraje.problem1: Who is it for and what problem does it solve?
factoraje.problem2: Inverfin Financial Factoring is designed for companies that sell on credit and want to convert their accounts receivable into immediate cash flow.
factoraje.problem-card2: Companies and Individuals with Business Activity (PFAE) that sell on credit, mainly to corporations, retail chains, and creditworthy companies, looking to convert their accounts receivable into liquidity.
factoraje.problem-card4: Many companies face cash gaps due to deferred invoice collections, limiting their ability to accept new orders or cover expenses. Factoring enables early invoice collection and shortens the cash cycle without waiting for maturity.
factoraje.process2: Our process is designed to be agile and transparent. In six steps, you can advance the collection of your invoices and obtain immediate liquidity.
factoraje.process-card2: Register your company on our platform and get pre-approval for your credit line.
factoraje.process-card4: Complete the document check to finalize the analysis and authorization of your line.
factoraje.process-card6: Upload and submit your invoices for validation on the platform.
factoraje.process-card8: Sign contracts, annexes, and promissory notes to formalize the transaction.
factoraje.process-card10: Receive up to 90% of the value of eligible invoices in advance.
factoraje.process-card12: Upon maturity of the invoices, we follow up on collections and settle the remaining balance.
factoraje.faq2: We resolve your most common questions about Inverfin Financial Factoring.
factoraje.q1_question: What is financial factoring and how does it work?
factoraje.q1_answer: It is a solution that allows you to advance the collection of your invoices to gain liquidity before your client pays them.
factoraje.q2_question: Which companies can apply for factoring with Inverfin?
factoraje.q2_answer: Companies and Individuals with Business Activity (PFAE) that invoice on credit to corporate clients or retail chains with eligible accounts receivable.
factoraje.q3_question: Do I need to assign all of my invoices?
factoraje.q3_answer: No, you can advance only the invoices you need.
factoraje.q4_question: How much money can I receive for an invoice?
factoraje.q4_answer: Up to 80%–90% of the value of eligible invoices, subject to analysis.
factoraje.q5_question: Will my clients know that I am using factoring?
factoraje.q5_answer: It depends on the modality: there are schemes with and without client notification.
factoraje.q6_question: What happens if my client pays after the due date?
factoraje.q6_answer: The transaction is managed according to what was agreed, under recourse or non-recourse schemes.
factoraje.q7_answer: The process begins with digital onboarding and an agile analysis of documentation.
factoraje.q8_question: Can I use my line more than once?
factoraje.q8_answer: Yes, with a revolving line you can continue advancing new invoices.
factoraje.q9_question: What advantages does it have over traditional credit?
factoraje.q9_answer: You obtain liquidity directly from your credit sales, strengthening your working capital.
factoraje.cta2: At Inverfin we help you convert your accounts receivable into immediate liquidity. Request your factoring line and receive personalized advice from our executives.

privacy.title: Comprehensive Privacy Policy
privacy.section1.title: Identity and Address of the Data Controller
privacy.section1.description1: (hereinafter referred to as "The Data Controller"), with tax and operational address in the Mexican Republic and official web portal https://inverfin.com.mx, is responsible for the collection, use, storage, transfer, and protection of your personal data, in strict compliance with the Federal Law on Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties (LFPDPPP), its Regulations, and related legal frameworks.
privacy.section2.title: Personal Data Subject to Processing
privacy.section2.description1: To carry out the purposes described in this document, we collect the following categories of personal data:
privacy.section2.list1: Identification and Contact Data: Full name or Company name, email address, phone number (landline or mobile), and subject collected via the contact form.
privacy.section2.list2: Tax and Financial Identification Data: Federal Taxpayer Registry (RFC), Unique Population Registry Code (CURP), Tax Identification Card (CIF), SAT Access Password (CIEC), and/or e.firma (in case of formal evaluation).
privacy.section2.list3: Financial, Asset, and Analytical Information: Proof of income, tax returns, tax status certificates, issued/received invoices, tax compliance opinion reports, as well as credit behavior and history.
privacy.section2.list4: Browsing and Technical Security Data: IP address, browser type, operating system, and security validation interaction through the Google reCAPTCHA API.
privacy.section3.title: Purposes of Data Processing and Credit Evaluation
privacy.section3.description1: The personal data collected will be used for the following primary purposes:
privacy.section3.sectionA.list1: Attend to, follow up on, and respond to requests submitted through our web form.
privacy.section3.sectionA.list2: Financial and Credit Viability Assessment: By providing us with your RFC and tax/financial information, the data will be processed and integrated to initiate credit analysis, asset risk assessment, and viability opinion for granting financing lines, leasing, or other requested corporate products.
privacy.section3.sectionA.list3: Inquiry before Tax Authorities and Credit Reporting Agencies: With your prior consent, your personal and tax data may be cross-checked and investigated before the Tax Administration Service (SAT) and Credit Reporting Agencies (such as Buró de Crédito and/or Círculo de Crédito).
privacy.section3.sectionA.list4: Prevent cyberattacks, automated mass traffic, and fraud through the use of Google reCAPTCHA.
privacy.section3.sectionA.list5: Comply with anti-money laundering obligations, regulatory audits, and reports to competent authorities in accordance with Mexican legislation.
privacy.section3.sectionB.list1: Commercial prospecting, sending market newsletters, promotions, and updates regarding Inverfin's leasing or financing services.
privacy.section4.title: Transfer of Personal Data to Third Parties and Specialized Vendors
privacy.section4.description1: We inform you that for the execution of the credit viability analysis and tax inquiry, Inverfin transfers data with the technology provider Syntage (SATWS, S.A.P.I. de C.V.), an authorized technology infrastructure that facilitates interconnection and automated extraction of tax information directly from SAT servers and data collection for credit risk profiling.
privacy.section4.description2: Syntage acts as a data processor under equivalent encryption and technical security standards, subject to the provisions of the LFPDPPP and its own privacy policy available at syntage.com/aviso-de-privacidad.
privacy.section4.description3: Except for legal requirements issued by authorities or the required transfer to Credit Reporting Agencies and Syntage for credit evaluation, Inverfin will not sell, commercialize, or transfer your personal data to any other unrelated third party.
privacy.section5.title: Use of Cookies and Security Measures
privacy.section5.description1: Our website uses technical and analytical cookies to optimize browsing. The use of contact forms is protected by Google reCAPTCHA v3/v2 technology. The technical interaction with said tool is subject to the Terms of Service and Google Privacy Policy.
privacy.section6.title: Exercise of ARCO Rights and Revocation of Consent
privacy.section6.description1: You have the right to know what personal data we have about you, what we use it for, and the conditions of its use (Access); request the correction of your personal information (Rectification); request its deletion from our records or databases (Cancellation); as well as object to the use of your data for specific purposes (Opposition).
privacy.section6.description2: To exercise any of the ARCO rights or to revoke consent for tax and credit analysis, you must send a formal request to the official customer support email:
privacy.section6.description4: The request must include: (i) Full name of the data subject and reply email address, (ii) Valid official ID proving your identity, (iii) Clear description of the data regarding which you seek to exercise your right. Response time will be a maximum of 20 business days.
privacy.section7.title: Changes to the Privacy Policy
privacy.section7.description1: This privacy policy may undergo modifications or updates resulting from legal requirements or our own operational practices. Such modifications will be available on the official website: https://inverfin.com.mx/aviso-privacidad.
